summary:
After hardening the competence harness (applied-correctness LLM judge + control probes, cold-rate must be strictly in (0,1)), the honest re-run on the orchestrator repo is DEGENERATE: cold 11/11, kb 11/11, kb_earned_project=0. The cold agent correctly answered all 7 project-specific probes (overlay architecture, set_task_repo precedence, merge --abort, lexical search, stuck-loop escalation, desktop hooks, output_tokens metric) WITHOUT the KB — by reading the source. Structural finding (consistent with v5 NO-WIN): for project knowledge that a capable model can recover by reading the code, an ingested KB adds NOTHING to correctness. Ingest's value, if any, must lie in (a) NON-recoverable knowledge — decision rationale, tried-and-reverted approaches, unwritten conventions, cross-session/cross-repo memory — or (b) COST/latency (not having to re-derive by exploring), NOT correctness on recoverable facts. The harness is now trustworthy and correctly refuses to manufacture a signal.</summary>
